GDPa1.binding_rule: Do not assume 242 or 246. Bind the exact accepted artifact version, row set and SHA-256 after authorized access; then freeze before running CPG-001 replication.
evidence_limitations: Access is gated; no file hash or row set may be asserted until authorized access materializes the exact artifact.
Use the dataset versioning sheet/full datasheet where available; do not infer 242 versus 246 from prose.

JAIN_2017.binding_rule: Real replay MUST record the exact supplementary artifact filename and SHA-256 before any threshold tuning or outcome inspection.
evidence_limitations: Published supplementary data can bind antibody row, sequence and matched-IgG1 study context after exact artifact hashing.

The public historical dataset does not provide native OpenLine per-assay receipt IDs or complete per-candidate wet-lab batch/run provenance. Historical replay therefore tests promotion-policy behavior, not native receipt provenance.
JAIN_2017.source: Jain et al., Biophysical properties of the clinical-stage antibody landscape, PNAS 2017
